English: Palisade Fence
A rudimentary barrier of sharpened wooden stakes, hastily erected for basic protection on the frontier.
Earthen Embankment
A broad, sloped earthwork topped with timber, offering improved defense and a base for future stonework.
Timber Rampart
A reinforced wooden wall with walkways for defenders, providing greater resistance to attackers.
Dry Stone Wall
A wall of carefully stacked stones set without mortar, robust against attackers and the elements.
Mortared Stone Wall
A formidable stone barrier set with lime mortar, greatly increasing defensive strength and long-term durability.
Crenellated Curtain
A high stone curtain wall with crenellations, allowing defenders to shelter and return fire effectively.
Reinforced Battlements
Curtain walls strengthened with stone buttresses and improved battlements, providing superior defense and command points.
Machicolated Walls
Curtain walls equipped with machicolations, allowing defenders to rain missiles and objects upon besiegers.
Thickened Bulwark
Massively thick stone walls, layered for resistance against siege engines and undermining, forming a nearly impregnable bulwark.
Star Bastion
A cutting-edge star-shaped bastion with angled walls, designed to resist cannon fire and maximize defensive firepower.
